name: neruva-crewai
summary: Drop-in CrewAI memory integration for Neruva. Replaces CrewAI's default storage with Records + KG federation. Substrate (v0.5.7) adds typed-shape context dispatch, tenant-specific PII rules, depth-unlimited nested-belief tracking, counterfactual rollouts, EFE planner, continual learning. Deterministic from seed (bit-identical replay). Persists across crew runs, supports semantic search via agent_recall, optional entity tracking via the HD knowledge graph. One-line install.
